annotations.title: Get a candidate's FEC campaign money

description: Campaign money for one person from FEC filings: cash on hand, total receipts and total disbursements, with the filing period end date. Federal candidates and officeholders only; state and local campaigns file with their state, so those return hasFecData false with a note instead of numbers. Read-only public data from open.fec.gov.
